description: Get an ERC-20 allowance with the owner's balance and a sufficiency verdict for the amount you plan to pull. ERC-20 allowance of a spender on an owner (USDC by default), with the owner's balance and, if you pass ?amount=, a verdict: is the allowance sufficient, is the balance sufficient. Base mainnet. Query: ?owner=0x…&spender=0x…&token=0x…&amount=12.5 — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "usdc allowance of a spender", "is this approval sufficient", "check erc20 allowance on base".
name: chain_allowance
